name: Satisfactory
description: Satisfactory dedicated server. The game port is 7777 by convention and is used on both UDP (game) and TCP (server API); the Reliable Messaging port is TCP and is 8888 by convention. The server name and admin password are not set here: the first player to connect claims the server in the game's Server Manager.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Most players that can be connected at once. The game is designed for 4; more works but is not officially supported.

variables.name: Rotating Autosaves
variables.description: How many autosaves are kept before the oldest is overwritten.

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: Leave empty for the stable release or choose experimental. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. The installer and the update check on start both use it.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Check Steam for a game update every time the server starts.
